none.why: The Red Skull appears only in the World War II flashback of "Old Soldiers" (#73), which features Wolverine, Captain America, Cocteau and the Howling Commandos; Storm is not in that episode and never deals with the Red Skull anywhere in the series. none.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
none.why: Captain America shows up only in flashbacks: an on-screen cameo in Wolverine's memories in "Red Dawn" and the WWII mission with Logan in "Old Soldiers" (#73). Rogue is in "Red Dawn" but never deals with him, and she is not in "Old Soldiers". Their first exchange is in X-Men '97#7, which already has a stage. Sources: https://marvel.fandom.com/api.php?action=parse&page=X-Men:_The_Animated_Series_Season_2_4&prop=wikitext&format=json ; https://marvel.fandom.com/api.php?action=parse&page=Steven_Rogers_(Earth-92131)&prop=wikitext&format=json
